adaptation_warning: official experiment is multi-channel softmax Dice:CE:ACE=1:1:1 long training; project is single-channel sigmoid WT and adds ACE1 to historical Dice1+CE0.1 continuation

matched_control.source: existing teacher-free control from KAS experiment

only_changed_factor: add weight1 foreground single-channel hard mL1-ACE auxiliary loss

hard_ml1ace.boundary_semantics: probabilities exactly at internal boundary belong to lower bin; use torch.bucketize directly, never floor(p*num_bins)
hard_ml1ace.bin_statistics: stream count,sum_probability,sum_ground_truth per occupied bin; no membership matrix
hard_ml1ace.reduction: occupied bins mean, then batch mean

fixed_training.sampler: weighted replacement,756 samples/epoch,same control Generator seed

fixed_validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum hACE Scan Dice among208/216/224/232; Subject exact tie-break

calibration.macro_ace: per-scan occupied-bin ACE then scan mean
calibration.official_micro_ace: per-bin mean_p nanmean across scans; mean_gt count weighted across scans; occupied-bin mean absolute gap
calibration.pooled_voxel_ace: both p and gt pooled by voxel count, supplemental only

promotion_gates_all_required: selected hACE scan and subject strictly beat same-epoch control
selected hACE scan and subject strictly beat KD200
paired scan and subject CI lower versus KD200 at least -0.003
macro ACE at least0.005 lower than same-epoch control and paired macro-ACE CI upper below0
official-micro ACE strictly lower than same-epoch control
all pairing, implementation, smoke, reload, deploy, hash and access gates pass

technical_stop_gates.reference: official hard-bin values/counts and boundary cases match frozen synthetic reference
technical_stop_gates.gradient: ACE-to-logit gradient finite and nonzero; assignment detached but probability mean attached
technical_stop_gates.loss: ACE, supervised,total and gradient norm finite
technical_stop_gates.deploy: all checkpoint reload and deploy differences zero

if_gates_fail: stop without bin count,right,ACE weight,start,LR,epoch,checkpoint,threshold or postprocessing search; do not access test270

primary_brats_wt_evidence.interpretation: source supports calibration improvement, not WT Dice improvement
